result.reason: The clause is mutual, contains no no-hire restriction, and preserves carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. However, the 12-month period runs from the end of the Agreement rather than from the end of each employee’s involvement in the services, so it can exceed the fallback position. The added contact requirement and six-month former-employee carve-out are favorable but unnecessary deviations, and the latter is unclear as to the date from which six months is measured.
